x: In the 100 yards senior race we saw Denis Merrett beat Basil Walden by inches with our new member, I. Mayers, in third place. The 100 yards junior final resulted in a win for Alan Law with Frank Kemp second and J.
In the Senior events we saw Ron Holtum win the first 100 yards, with Ivan Mayers winning the second race, and Mayers also won his 220 yards race, with Dicky Bartlett winning the other 220 yards.
Our team of Holtum, Marshall, Walden and Mayers were drawn on the outside and with Marshall being short of training we could only finish in 6th place.
Held at the White City on July 10th-11th, and on the Friday we saw the heats of the 100 yards, and we had Holtum, Mayers and Walden competing, but without success.

Denis was also 2nd in the 100 yards and our other sprinters Mayers, Walden and Holtum all ran well in their heats of 100 and 220 yards. Ted Gaworski took 2nd place in the Shot put with a personal best and Mal Ash was 2nd in the High Jump and 5th in the hurdles.
A new holder was also produced in the Senior 100 yards, the finalists being Mayers, Walden, Butler, Merrett, Key and Holtum., Merrett eventually winning from Mayers with Walden third.
The first track event was the heats of the 100 yards in which both Holtum and Mayers qualified for the final, won later by Ivan with Ron third.

Ivan Mayers reached the semi-final of the 220 yards in which he ran extremely well and Ted Gaworski gave his usual polished performances in the Shot and Discus, although not reaching the coveted placed positions.
The 4 x 110 team of Merritt, Holtum, Jones and Mayers won their heat in 43.3secs., the fastest of the two, which looked as though we had a very good chance in the final.
The Field Events Section however, were conspicuous by their absence, as will be seen by the fact that Ivan Mayers won the Shot Put in addition to completing the double in the sprints.
Our 4 x 110 yds. team of Mayers, Carter, Jones and Holtum took second place in the final to T.V.H. We seem to have gathered a fine quartet of 440 men in Dollimore, Jackson, Leroy and Morris.
